Method of Attack: Exploiting vulnerabilities in IoT devices to take control for DDoS attacks
Downloading botnet client matching device architecture
Deleting client file after execution to evade detection
Bypassing encrypted string table initialization for stealth
Manual exploitation of vulnerabilities (no brute forcing telnet/SSH)
Discoverer: Unit 42 researchers of Palo Alto Networks
Impacted Systems: TP-Link devices (including TP-Link Archer A21 AX1800 WiFi router)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of at least 22 known vulnerabilities in connected products
Shell script execution from external resource
